structured.answer: A פיקדון means locking money in the bank for a set time for a small interest rate (1.8% in the example), minus 15% tax. If you want it early, the bank has to agree and you pay a fine the page never puts in shekels. Their own example shows 70,000 ₪ put in and only 68,270 ₪ left after 10 years, so I wouldn't open one today.

stuck.why: 68,270 ₪ 'נשאר לכם' is less than 70,000 ₪ 'ההפקדות שלכם'. It looks like I lose money. I guess it's about 'בכסף של היום' and 2% inflation, but I'm not sure.
